instructions: Directory, board, appointment and call-summary data come from the operational service; hospital answers and routing decisions come from the knowledge service.

get_doctor_availability.description: Doctor or department availability for today or an explicit future date; WORKING_HOURS returns usual hours without board or slot checks. Today is LIVE_BOARD: status is Manoj's IN, LATE, CANCELLED, NOT_CONFIRMED or UNKNOWN; decision is the separate MCP result. With slots enabled, a selected doctor's date is checked against slots: openSlots lists the owner's open blocks when the session permits a request; [] means checked and no block is offered (none open, or the session does not permit a request), null means not checked. For ordinary doctors, UNKNOWN always requires callback, even if another source says CANCELLED; NOT_CONFIRMED with an open bookable block permits a request, noted for desk confirmation. CANCELLED is NOT_AVAILABLE; no open slot is NOT_AVAILABLE/NO_OPEN_SLOT. A supplied passed end time means NOT_AVAILABLE/SESSION_ENDED; a missing end time is not an ended session. An ON_CALL doctor needs a confirmed IN/LATE entry with a usable window or open block; otherwise HANDOFF_REQUIRED means desk assistance, without callback metadata. A cancelled on-call session remains NOT_AVAILABLE. Future dates rely on slots when enabled, including desk-added oneDay sessions for that date only; a one-day session with null hours has no bookable time. With slots disabled, IN/LATE permit a request today, ordinary NOT_CONFIRMED/UNKNOWN require callback, and future regular/visiting hours describe usual attendance days, attendance not confirmed. Several sessions with the same decision require no session choice; differing decisions may require one. Department searches with slots enabled return DOCTORS_MATCHED and SLOT_CHECK_REQUIRED when doctors match: doctors match the request, not yet available; slot availability is known after a doctor-specific check, with bookableFound=0 for these matches. With slots disabled, department AVAILABILITY lists bookable doctors when any exist; otherwise callback, handoff or unavailable facts. Results are capped by the configured limit. totalMatches is the directory count across all types and decisions; bookableFound counts bookable doctors found among those checked, potentially more than the returned list; complete means every directory candidate was evaluated, not that every doctor's slots were read. An incomplete search with no match is HANDOFF_REQUIRED/SEARCH_INCOMPLETE, not unavailability. WORKING_HOURS with hours returns PRESENT_WORKING_HOURS for one doctor and always bookableFound=0; an empty ordinary schedule returns CALLBACK_REQUIRED, while an on-call doctor requires HANDOFF_REQUIRED. Department WORKING_HOURS keeps on-call handoff facts within the list limit. Callback details are stored only in record_call_summary as CALLBACK_NOTED. Ambiguous names return choices.

parameters.doctorName: Doctor name for directory search, in the caller's original wording; optional.
parameters.doctorId: Directory identifier for a selected doctor; optional alternative to doctorName.
parameters.departmentName: Department or speciality name for directory search; optional.
parameters.departmentId: Directory identifier for a selected department; optional alternative to departmentName.
parameters.date: 'today' or YYYY-MM-DD; required for AVAILABILITY, optional for WORKING_HOURS. Other relative dates are not accepted.
parameters.session: Optional selected session label; limits requested-date or working-hours sessions. Blank means no selection.
parameters.gender: Optional doctor gender filter: FEMALE or MALE.
parameters.purpose: AVAILABILITY (default) checks a requested date; WORKING_HOURS returns normal working hours or attendance days, not live availability.

manage_booking.description: Appointment request operations: CREATE, LIST, CANCEL and RESCHEDULE. Writes require callerConfirmed=true and trusted call/operation headers. CREATE requires patientName, patientMobile, doctorId and visitDate; department-level appointments are unsupported. LIST/CANCEL/RESCHEDULE require verified caller identity. With slots enabled, CREATE requires preferredTime and RESCHEDULE requires newPreferredTime: the time belongs within returned openSlots. Missing time returns TIME_REQUIRED/ASK_WHICH_TIME with choices. session is optional; a supplied nonblank label must match the session containing that time. Blank means no selection; session is internal MCP context, absent from the owner request. Today uses the live board and slots; future dates rely on slots when enabled. Ordinary UNKNOWN requires CALLBACK_REQUIRED and no write; NOT_CONFIRMED with an open bookable block can be NOTED: noted, the desk will confirm. ON_CALL without a confirmed IN/LATE entry and a usable window or open block requires HANDOFF_REQUIRED/TRANSFER_DESK without callback metadata; cancelled sessions are NOT_AVAILABLE. With slots disabled, today uses the board and future regular/visiting dates follow usual hours, attendance not confirmed; time is optional, differing decisions without session/time selection yield SESSION_REQUIRED/ASK_WHICH_SESSION, and a specific time without a known end yields HANDOFF_REQUIRED/TIME_NOT_VERIFIABLE. NOTED records a create or reschedule request, not a confirmed or reserved time; appointment.status preserves the owner status. slotTime is the time recorded for this request: the owner's slotTime (block start), otherwise expectedTime, otherwise null. slotMoved is true only if the owner returned a different block, such as for a late doctor or passed time; choosing 10:45 and receiving its 10:30 block start is not moved. CALLBACK_REQUIRED means no write and callback facts belong only in a call summary. NOT_AVAILABLE means the selected session/time is unavailable; NO_OPEN_SLOT means the session has no open slot, SLOT_FULL means that time is full, and TIME_OUTSIDE_SESSION means outside known bounds or, with slots, no block contains the time, the containing block is closed or ended, or a supplied session label does not match its session. With slots, the selected session is the supplied one, otherwise the one containing the time. When it is not bookable or has no open block, its session reason applies (NO_OPEN_SLOT or SESSION_ENDED); otherwise a time in one of its full blocks is SLOT_FULL, and a time in none of its open or full blocks is TIME_OUTSIDE_SESSION. Checked alternatives are the sessions/openSlots in this result; an owner SLOT_FULL write rejection carries none and establishes no availability at other times. UNCERTAIN means a write may have committed without a verified result; desk handoff is the disposition, not retry. A later invocation with the same operation id re-runs the schedule check and can be refused; refusal does not prove the earlier write failed.

parameters.action: Required action: CREATE, LIST, CANCEL or RESCHEDULE.
parameters.patientName: Required for CREATE: patient name; nonblank, at most 100 characters.
parameters.patientMobile: Required for CREATE: 10-digit contact mobile. This is contact data, not caller authority.
parameters.doctorId: Required for CREATE: identifier of the selected doctor. Department-level appointments are unsupported.
parameters.visitDate: Required for CREATE: 'today' or YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the facility date.
parameters.preferredTime: CREATE time in HH:MM 24-hour format; required when slots are enabled, chosen within returned openSlots. Optional when slots are disabled; a request, not a reservation.
parameters.session: Optional CREATE or RESCHEDULE session label; blank means no selection. With slots enabled, a supplied label must match the session containing the chosen time; an unlabelled session cannot match it. Internal MCP context, absent from the owner request. With slots disabled, a session or time selection resolves differing decisions.
parameters.reasonVerbatim: Optional CREATE/CANCEL reason in the caller's original words; forwarded without interpretation.
parameters.appointmentId: Required for CANCEL/RESCHEDULE: identifier of the appointment request.
parameters.newVisitDate: Required for RESCHEDULE: 'today' or YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the facility date.
parameters.newPreferredTime: RESCHEDULE time in HH:MM 24-hour format; required when slots are enabled, chosen within returned openSlots. Optional when slots are disabled.
parameters.callerConfirmed: Boolean declaring the caller's approval of this write; true is required for CREATE/CANCEL/RESCHEDULE.
parameters.fromDate: Optional LIST lower date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format; past dates are accepted.
parameters.toDate: Optional LIST upper date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format; past dates are accepted.

search_knowledge.description: One knowledge-service request for hospital information or symptom-to-department routing. It does not read availability or change appointments. ANSWERED and CLARIFICATION_NEEDED carry owner-provided text in answer.text. Routing results carry text only in routing.speak, when present. TRANSFER_EMERGENCY means the knowledge service decided the caller needs emergency help; TRANSFER_DESK means desk assistance; CHECK_AVAILABILITY identifies a department in routing.department. NO_ANSWER is an owner decision; COULD_NOT_CHECK is a service failure.

parameters.question: Required original question, untranslated and unsummarised; nonblank, maximum 500 characters.
parameters.language: Required nonblank language code, up to 16 characters; forwarded unchanged to the knowledge service.

record_call_summary.description:
Stores one summary per call, covering the whole conversation. The first accepted summary for a call is final. Call identity and start time come from trusted headers. One intent and outcome represent the call; other results are described in summaryText. A valid explicit callerMobile takes precedence; when omitted or null, the caller header supplies contact if it converts to the configured national format. Invalid explicit contact is rejected. Ordinary summaries may have no usable contact; CALLBACK_NOTED requires one and creates no appointment or callback task. Summary contact grants no appointment authority.
SAVED: a new summary was stored.
ALREADY_SAVED: a summary for this call is already stored and nothing was changed, including when the submitted text differs.
INVALID_REQUEST: input validation failed; fields identifies rejected fields.
NOT_CONFIRMED: persistence is unverified or temporarily unavailable.
NOT_SAVED: trusted call context is missing or invalid, or the operational service refused credentials.

parameters.summaryText: Required. Summary of the whole call in plain sentences, up to 500 characters: what the caller asked, what was explained or done, and any follow-up promised. Contains all relevant information mentioned in the call, including: the caller's name, the callback phone number, the symptoms or reason the caller described, the doctor's name, the department, and the requested date, time, session and callback reason. Not a transcript.
parameters.callerMobile: Optional 10-digit contact number. A valid explicit value takes precedence; omitted or null uses the converted X-Caller-Number when usable. Invalid explicit values are rejected. CALLBACK_NOTED requires a usable resolved contact; other outcomes may omit it. Contact does not grant appointment authority.
parameters.language: Optional call language; en, kn and hi primary codes map to the operational contract. Other codes are omitted upstream.
parameters.doctorId: Optional identifier of the doctor associated with the call.
parameters.appointmentId: Optional identifier of the appointment request associated with the call.
parameters.transferredTo: Optional destination associated with a transfer outcome.
